chart.compare_cutoff: Snapshot {{date}} holds no data past its own date — those measurements had not been recorded yet.

dialog.title: View entity history
dialog.subtitle: pick the interval to look inside
dialog.local_time_note: Times are shown in your local timezone; the request is sent in UTC.
dialog.system_time_title: This is not the observation date filter.
dialog.system_time_body: It selects versions by when the record was edited (system time), not by when the measurement was taken. A station edited yesterday appears here even if its readings are from March.
dialog.overlap_note: Any version that overlaps the window is included.
dialog.error_reversed: The start of the window must be before its end.
dialog.error_incomplete: Both ends of the window are required.

table.open_history_tooltip: Version history of this Thing — its name, description and properties

page.bad_window: That link has an unusable time window
page.load_failed: The history could not be read
page.empty_body: Nothing was written to this entity between those two instants. Widen the window to reach earlier versions.
page.not_versioned_title: This type has no version history
page.not_versioned_body: {{set}} is not kept under system-time versioning, so there are no versions to compare. Commits cause versions rather than having them.
page.version_count_truncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} versions in this window

rail.counts_note: Counts are versions inside the window. A related entity that did not change is listed with zero rather than hidden. A relation too large to list shows its changes instead: edits and deletions.
rail.too_many: {{n}} in total — too many to list
rail.changes_hint: Edits and deletions inside this window.

diff.single_title: Only one version in this window
diff.single_body: This entity was written once and has not changed since. Widen the window to reach earlier versions.
diff.same_title: Both sides are the same version
diff.same_body: Pick a different version on either side to see what changed between them.
diff.identical_body: Every field matches. The commit still exists — a version can be written without a visible field change.
diff.no_match_body: Clear the filter to see all {{count}} changed fields.

start.question: Which values does this datastream use for quality?
start.current_desc: Keep what the chart uses now and adjust it.

istsos.name: istSOS quality index
istsos.desc: 100 is good; 90–93 are the SaQC codes; anything else below 100 is out of range.

ftp.name: ftp2istsos4 bit pairs
ftp.desc: 3 means all checks OK, 2 a problem, 1 still pending, 0 not run.

mqtt.name: mqtt2istsos4
mqtt.desc: 11 means OK and 0 means not checked. Anything else is suspect.

blank.name: Blank
blank.desc: Start with no rules and write your own.

values.title: Stored in this window
values.note_start: Colours show the verdict under the option you picked. Highlighted rows change verdict.
values.note_rules: + Rule adds a rule for that exact value at the top of the list.

rules.intro: Rules are checked from the top. The first match decides the verdict.
rules.incomplete: Enter a number to turn this rule on.
rules.shadowed: Never used: rule {{rules}} already catches every value this rule could match. Move it up or change it.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Add one below, or use + Rule next to a stored value.
rules.no_value_note: never judged, never counted in the pass rate

review.same: These rules give the same verdicts as the current ones for every reading in this window.
review.saves_datastream: {{name}} only, in this browser. Nobody else's chart changes.
review.saves_source: Every datastream from {{source}} without rules of its own, in this browser. Nobody else's chart changes.
review.labels_note: Colours stay fixed so the lane reads the same on every chart.

footer.draft_early: Draft · nothing is saved until the last step
footer.draft_final: Draft · saving applies it to the chart right away
footer.no_changes: No changes from the rules in use
